name: Senior engineer seeking an 80% role near Stuttgart

context.geography: Near Stuttgart; commute up to 40 km
context.employment_state: Employed; considering a change for reduced hours
context.company_awareness: Knows regional manufacturers; also open to discovering smaller employers

trigger: Recurring late project meetings make the present full-time arrangement unsustainable; the engineer looks for a reduced-hours role without starting over professionally.

searches_run.observation: The sample returned the federal job search, employer pages and adjacent engineering roles. Federal results visibly mixed experienced positions with student roles; a part-time tag alone did not resolve seniority.

searches_run.query: Ingenieur Teilzeit Stuttgart 32 Stunden planbare Arbeitszeiten Hersteller
searches_run.observation: Results included a K2 Systems technical design role with a 32-hour minimum, general flexible-working claims and unrelated roles. The directly inspected K2 posting specifies hours and location but is not a demonstrated senior mechanical-engineering match.

sources.title: Jobs für Ingenieur/in Maschinenbau in Teilzeit in Stuttgart — Bundesagentur für Arbeit
sources.supports: Retrieved public employment-service result contains both engineering and student roles under part-time, illustrating the need to inspect role type. Counts are not treated as market size.

sources.title: Technischer Produktdesigner Fachrichtung Maschinen- und Anlagenkonstruktion — K2 Systems
sources.supports: Directly inspected employer ATS page states permanent full/part-time work in Renningen, at least 32 hours weekly, CAD duties and some mobile working. It does not establish fixed daily hours or a senior engineer vacancy.

best_entry_page.promise: Find regional engineering employers and learn to distinguish stated hours, workload percentages and general flexibility before following their openings.
best_entry_page.cta: Select nearby employers and save an engineering search.
proof_needed: Demonstrate experienced roles rather than student-heavy examples.
Show percentage and hours as reported; do not assume 80% means 32 hours for every employer.
Verify commute manually from actual workplace; radius routing is not demonstrated.
Show source text for working hours and unknown daily schedules.
New indexable guide required; existing search pages are noindex.

conversion_objections: Does part-time really include senior engineering work?
Can I preserve responsibility without compressing five days of work into four?
Are manufacturers near my home covered?
Will vague flexibility claims pass the description checks?
Do I need Pro merely to read working hours?

avoid_targeting.reason: Legal entitlement advice is outside this product journey.
Workload and overtime cannot be guaranteed from a posting.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Ich suche keine Karriereberatung, sondern eine erfahrene Ingenieurstelle mit wirklich passendem Stundenumfang. Zeigt mir konkrete Angaben zu Wochenstunden und Arbeitsort; allgemeine Flexibilität reicht mir nicht.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic, gender-neutral persona. Two queries and one employer-page inspection reveal retrieval ambiguity, not regional supply, conversion or search volume. The exact home location and schedule preferences are unspecified; 40 km cannot be assessed from Stuttgart city centre.

search_journey.fit_reason: Employment-type filtering supports part-time; exact percentage and daily pattern still require description evidence.
Explicit percentages can be assessed in descriptions when present.
